run_stereo_agent_simulation: run a habitat-sim stereo agent simulation with RGB and depth sensors in a 3D scene
run_main_with_scene: run the main function with a custom GLB scene path and output store directory
run_no_display_mode: run the stereo agent simulation in headless mode with the --no-display flag
create_stereo_sensor_config: create left and right RGB and depth camera sensor specs with Gaussian noise
render_stereo_observations: render 50 random navigation steps saving stereo RGB images and depth maps to disk
